summary: Phase 149O.15 -- HATP Mandatory Production Consumption Contract Freeze: contract-freeze-only phase, zero src/pcae/** changes and zero changes to any pre-existing contract file. Ran the required initial inspection (git status/branch/log/rev-list, pcae health/check/status coherence/doctor task-memory/push check/runtime inspect, telegram notify status, phase-report show --latest and reconcile --phase-id 149O.14) and confirmed the expected baseline: repo clean, origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.14 completed/complete/pushed, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable, PB execution_unavailable. Removed a stale duplicate active-task file left over from the 149O.6 era (tasks/active/...post-149o-6.md), flagged by pcae doctor task-memory, as task-lifecycle hygiene while opening this phase's task. Read, directly and in full (not summarized from prior phase reports), docs/PHASE_149O_14_HATP_AG3_AG5_MANDATORY_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_ARCHITECTURE.md (including the exact MC-1..MC-13 invariants and the exact 45-scenario future attack matrix, independently re-counted at exactly 45), and all six upstream contracts this new contract depends on: HSCE-001 v1.1, HATP-001 v1.0, RAE-001 v1.0, RWMPC-001 v1.0, PBPA-001 v1.0, PBPC-001 v1.2. Read production source directly: core/hatp_evidence_store.py (HATPEvidenceStore.load, explicit-ID-only), core/hatp_ag_authority.py (confirmed its PB request is unconditionally simulation_only=True), core/rollback_approval_evidence.py (the exact approval_present derivation chain), core/human_approval_trusted_provenance.py (verify_hatp_proof's exact ordered checks and closed status vocabulary), core/permission_broker.py and core/permission_broker_foundation.py (DECISION_ALLOW/DENY/HUMAN_REVIEW, ExecutionDisabledRule/POL-005's exact simulation_only trigger, COMPONENT_REGISTRY confirming COMP-002/COMP-008 remain not_implemented), core/agent.py (execute_rollback and build_rollback_execution's exact current signatures, gate sequences, and effect calls), commands/agent.py (confirmed both real CLI call sites pass zero HATP kwargs today), commands/hatp.py, and cli.py. Identified and explicitly resolved, rather than deferring, the central open question 149O.14 left unsettled: whether a PB ALLOW obtained under today's architecture's fixed simulation_only=True request can authorize a real rollback effect once HATP_MANDATORY applies. Determined it cannot -- PBPC-001 already establishes that a truthful simulation_only=False request deterministically resolves DENY given today's execution_unavailable runtime posture (COMP-002/COMP-008 not_implemented) -- and froze this as a new security invariant, MC-14 (the Effect-Truthful PB Requirement): a real AG3/AG5 effect may only cross the Mandatory Consumption Boundary on the strength of a truthfully non-simulated, ALLOW-resolving PB decision, which today's architecture cannot produce, so HATP_MANDATORY activation does not by itself guarantee rollback availability -- an explicit, accepted, frozen consequence rather than an ambiguity left to a future implementer. Authored and froze a new, standalone contract, docs/contracts/HATP_MANDATORY_ROLLBACK_CONSUMPTION_CONTRACT.md (HMRC-001 v1.0, HMRC-REQ-001 through HMRC-REQ-085, chosen over the candidate name HPC-001 for scope precision), covering: the exact --hatp-evidence-id evidence-reference syntax (identical flag name on both pcae remote rollback execute and pcae rollback --per-id, no alias); the canonical HATPEvidenceStore.load/HATPSignedEvidenceEnvelope consumption chain, reused unmodified; a closed, fail-closed enumeration of every evidence/verification failure mode with no post-cutover legacy fallback under any of them; reuse (not duplication) of the existing RAE/HATP approval-derivation conjunction and the existing PB request shape; the MC-14 resolution above; the exact old-hook (hatp_evidence_id/hatp_proof/hatp_evidence) disposition (hatp_evidence_id retained/canonical, hatp_proof and hatp_evidence deprecated/internal-only and forbidden as production caller input on the mandatory path); a closed list of forbidden caller-supplied inputs (approval booleans, PB decisions, cutover-mode overrides); the three-state LEGACY_COMPATIBLE -> PREPARED -> HATP_MANDATORY cutover model with no direct skip and no reverse transition for ordinary principals; a new admin-owned Cutover Record design stored under the existing Class-B protected HATP trust root (never agent-writable .pcae/), with a closed v1 schema (version/repository_instance_id/mode/activated_at/activated_by) and an explicit monotonicity mechanism (a separate write-once deployment-baseline marker) so record deletion or corruption can never silently downgrade a previously-activated deployment back to LEGACY_COMPATIBLE; exact legacy-command disposition for pcae remote rollback approve and rollback_approval_state across all three modes, with an explicit no-dual-authority, no-OR-condition guarantee; preservation of every existing AG3/AG5 structural/safety precondition as distinct from human-approval authority in every mode; the exact AG3 (inside execute_rollback, immediately before _run_git_revert) and AG5 (inside build_rollback_execution, immediately before the first real file mutation) mandatory-gate placement, covering direct function calls and not merely the CLI layer; MC-1..MC-14 security invariants (13 carried forward from 149O.14 plus the new MC-14); and the full 45-scenario attack matrix, reconciled exactly against the 149O.14 architecture document's own list (independently re-counted, no reduction, no addition), each scenario's expected result now citing the specific HMRC-REQ clause that produces it. Authored the phase document, docs/PHASE_149O_15_HATP_MANDATORY_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md, including the full required-final-report field set. Authored a new 37-test contract-verification file (tests/test_phase_149o_15_hatp_mandatory_production_consumption_contract_freeze.py, all passing) that independently re-verifies, rather than trusting the new contract's own prose: the contract's frozen identity/version/status; the HMRC-REQ sequence (sequential, no gaps, at least 80 requirements); the exact MC-1..MC-14 invariant sequence; the exact 45-row attack-matrix count; the exact --hatp-evidence-id flag string and absence of any alias outside the explicit prohibition; the exact AG3/AG5 CLI-target strings; the LEGACY_COMPATIBLE/PREPARED/HATP_MANDATORY vocabulary and the forbidden-skip transition rule; absence of any legacy_approved-OR-hatp_valid dual-authority language outside its own explicit prohibition; the forbidden-caller-input closed list; the effect-boundary-inside-the-function (not CLI-only) requirement; the cutover monotonicity requirement; the COMP-002/rollback-authority separation language; and, independently of the contract's own claims, the underlying current-state production facts the contract's design rests on -- execute_rollback's and build_rollback_execution's actual Wave-7 kwarg signatures, _run_git_revert as AG3's real effect call and the real write/unlink attributes as AG5's real effect calls, that real production call sites in commands/agent.py still pass zero HATP kwargs today, HATPEvidenceStore.load's explicit-ID-only shape with no latest/glob alternate, hatp_ag_authority.py's unconditional simulation_only=True (and confirmed absence of any simulation_only=False anywhere in that file today), ExecutionDisabledRule/POL-005's exact source-level trigger condition and COMP-002 reference, absence of any --hatp-evidence-id flag on the current cli.py, and that COMP-002/COMP-008 remain not_implemented in the component registry. Independently confirmed, via git diff against the phase-entering commit, that no src/pcae/** file and none of the six pre-existing contract files were touched by this phase. VERDICT: HMRC-001 v1.0 FROZEN -- READY FOR INDEPENDENT CONTRACT VERIFICATION (explicitly not VERIFIED). B-149O-1..4 remain INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED, not closed by this phase. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable.
